name: setup-wizard
title: Setup Wizard
summary: Turn human-only procedures into interactive bash wizards with captured values and confirmation gates.

use_when: Provisioning infrastructure or third-party accounts the agent has no access to
Capturing credentials or CI secrets from dashboards
One-off migrations or cutovers with irreversible steps
avoid_when: The steps are agent-runnable — automate them directly instead
The procedure is fully documented and short — a README checklist suffices
